summary: A future at Depth (client a) and Quote (client b): an OI packet before the first full packet publishes nothing; after it, a circuit packet and an OI packet each republish the last full packet with only their own fields changed, never a zero price.

notes: Prices, the band 1350/1650 and OI 777 from the web tests; the book and OI 700 on the full packet are added, and each partial has its own packet time.

Client b's Quote subscribe beside a's Depth leaves the instrument's highest mode at Depth, so the desktop's manager does not ask the feed for any frame; the web's adapter calls subscribe_scrips on every subscribe and its client sends a second subscribe at ALL here. Matching it would take a manager hook (shared code, lane wire): not in this case's upstream_receives.

deviations.reason: HDFC Sky sends lastTradeTime in epoch seconds (the web's own test pairs lastTradeTime 1700000000 with packetTimestamp 1700000000000); the web sends it unconverted as ltt, a docs key that is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it to ms (investright::trade_time_ms). Lead decision: ltt in seconds -> ms, web defect (wrong unit).

The HDFC Sky web adapter sends the change as change and change_percent only; the desktop also sends the canonical price_change and price_change_percent. Needs lane wire's canonical-change switch (per-broker key rule: canonical price_change* off for HDFC, change and change_percent kept).
